user.title: Bright Rooms
user.description: Bright Rooms switches the lights of each room with its presence sensors and the daylight. After this step, add the rooms from the integration page or from the Bright Rooms panel.

init.title: Settings
init.description: How the ambient light is computed and how each light's contribution is learned.

data.settle_seconds: Settling time after a light changes
data.learn_ambient_max: Learn only with ambient light up to
data.learn_min_previous: Learn only if the light was unchanged for

data_description.settle_seconds: The ambient light is held for this long after a room light changes: illuminance sensors report late and some lamps ramp up. It is also the time between the two readings of a measurement.
data_description.learn_ambient_max: Contributions are measured only with little daylight, when the jump of the sensor is clear.
data_description.learn_weight: A new measurement moves the learned value by this share (0.2 = 20 %).

error.area_taken: This area already has a room.
error.no_presence: Choose at least one presence sensor.
error.bright_not_above_dark: Must be higher than the dark threshold.
error.brightness_lux_order: Must be higher than the lowest brightness value.
error.light_in_other_room: One of these lights already belongs to another room.

user.title: Add room

data.other_lights: Other lights seen by the illuminance sensor
data.off_when_bright: Turn off when it becomes bright
data.zone_wait: Longest extra wait while a nearby area is occupied

data_description.presence_sensors: The room is occupied while at least one of them is on.
data_description.zone_sensors: While one of them is on, turning off waits longer: people often move between nearby areas and come back.
data_description.lights: The lights Bright Rooms switches. A light can belong to one room only.
data_description.illuminance_sensor: Optional. Without it the room always counts as dark and dimmable lights turn on at full brightness.
data_description.other_lights: Lights of other rooms that the illuminance sensor sees: a measurement of a light's contribution is discarded when one of them changes.
data_description.on_delay: Continuous presence needed before the lights turn on.
data_description.only_when_dark: Ambient light is measured without the room's own lights.
data_description.bright_above: Must be higher than the dark threshold: in between, the room keeps its previous state.
data_description.off_when_bright: Also with people in the room, but only when it goes from dark to bright: a light turned on by hand when it is already bright stays on.
data_description.min_off_seconds: For lamps that change tint when switched off and on quickly.
data_description.brightness_min: Dimmable lights: brightness when the ambient light is at or below the next value; 100 % at the full brightness value, linear in between.
data_description.empty_wait: With the room and the nearby areas empty, before dimming or turning off.
data_description.dim_percent: Dimmable lights are dimmed to this share of their brightness as a warning before turning off (100 % = no warning). If someone comes back, they return to their brightness.
